[[File:Hollowtoof chathead.png|left|100px]]
'''Hollowtoof''' is a [[goblin]] from [[Goblin Village]] and is the leader of the [[Goblin Raids]]. Players may talk to him before all the goblins are killed, with a [[combat level]] of at least 22, he will give the player a [[raider axe]], [[raider chainbody]] and a [[raider shield]]. Once all the other goblins are killed, he can be killed for the items too. He drops some of the best equipment available for free players, the [[gud raider axe]], [[gud raider chainbody]] and the [[gud raider shield]]. To receive a [[raider equipment]] drop and have a chance at receiving a [[Gud raider equipment]] drop, players must either deal the most damage of all players to Hollowtoof or deal damage greater than 10% of his lifepoints (over 5,000 lifepoints) in addition to killing at least one [[Goblin Raider]] by themselves. These mechanics are different for [[Ironman Mode]] accounts. Only the player doing the most damage to Hollowtoof will have their killcount updated.

Hollowtoof is stronger than his level would suggest; despite being only level 77, he can put up a good fight for even high-level players.

Players may [[Quick Chat]] their Hollowtoof killcount. However, the counter caps at 1,000 kills.

==Drops==
{{DropLogProject|jagex=yes}}
===100%===
One of the three pieces of raider gear is dropped. This piece will always be a piece the player does not currently own (unless they own all three items, where it will be any one of the three), chosen at random. (If the player has [[keepsake key|keepsaked]] their only copy of one of these, it will be considered unowned for this purpose.)
